Container.Name: ESPN-Fantasy-Football-Waivers
Container.Overview:
Emails you your ESPN fantasy football league's waiver results: who claimed whom, what they dropped, and the FAAB bid. ESPN doesn't send these itself.
Set your league ID and email (SMTP) settings below. Private leagues also need two cookies from espn.com, espn_s2 and SWID; each field below says where to find them, and the README has the full steps.
It reads your league's waiver schedule from ESPN and checks 5 minutes after each waiver run (then once a minute until ESPN has processed it), so there's nothing to look up. When no claims went through you get a short "No waiver claims today" email, so you know it's working. Those stop by themselves when the season ends and start again after next season's draft. You can also include free-agent pickups, drops and trades.
The first time it starts, it records your league's existing activity without emailing, so you only hear about new moves. If ESPN can't be reached for a while (for example, expired cookies), it emails you once.
Unofficial tool; not affiliated with or endorsed by ESPN.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: espn fantasy football waivers waiver results waiver wire faab email notification transactions league
Container.Changes: ### 1.1.0 - Checks 5 minutes after each of your league's waiver runs automatically, then every minute until ESPN has processed it (Check times: auto, the new default). - "No waiver claims today" emails stop when the season ends and resume after next season's draft. - No false "can't reach your league" alerts in the off-season before the league is renewed. ### 1.0.0 - First release.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Remembers which moves you've already been emailed about.

Config.Name: League ID
Config.Description: Open your league on fantasy.espn.com: it's the number after leagueId= in the address bar, e.g. 123456.

Config.Name: ESPN espn_s2 cookie
Config.Description: Private leagues only (most are). Log in at espn.com in Chrome or Edge, press F12, open Application > Cookies > https://fantasy.espn.com, type espn_s2 in the Filter box and click the row. Copy the whole value from the panel below the list (the table cuts it off), with 'Show URL-decoded' unticked. Don't click Log out on espn.com in that browser afterward, or the cookie stops working.

Config.Name: ESPN SWID cookie
Config.Description: Private leagues only. Same place as espn_s2: filter for SWID and copy its value, including the curly braces, e.g. {1A2B3C4D-...}.

Config.Name: Email to
Config.Description: Who gets the emails. Separate several addresses with commas, no spaces.

Config.Name: SMTP server
Config.Description: Mail server to send through. Gmail: smtp.gmail.com (port 587, starttls). Outlook/Hotmail: smtp-mail.outlook.com (587, starttls). iCloud: smtp.mail.me.com (587, starttls). Yahoo: smtp.mail.yahoo.com (465, ssl).

Config.Name: SMTP port
Config.Description: 587 for starttls, 465 for ssl.

Config.Name: SMTP security
Config.Description: starttls (port 587), ssl (port 465) or none.

Config.Name: SMTP username
Config.Description: Login for the account the emails are sent from, usually its full email address.

Config.Name: SMTP password
Config.Description: Most providers need an app password here, not your normal password. Gmail: turn on 2-Step Verification, then create one at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords and type it without spaces. iCloud and Yahoo have app passwords in their account security settings too.

Config.Name: Email from
Config.Description: Sender address. Leave blank to use the SMTP username.

Config.Name: Check times
Config.Description: auto (recommended): check 5 minutes after each of your league's waiver runs, using the schedule ESPN reports, then every minute until ESPN has processed the run. Or fixed 24-hour HH:MM times in your server's time zone, e.g. 09:15 or 09:15,13:00 (with Check days). Or interval to check every 15 minutes all week.

Config.Name: Check days
Config.Description: Only for fixed Check times: days to check, comma separated, no spaces, e.g. Wed,Thu,Fri,Sat,Sun. Blank means every day. Not needed with auto.

Config.Name: Notify about
Config.Description: Any of WAIVER (waiver claims), FA (free-agent pickups), TRADE (trades) and DROP (players dropped without a pickup), comma separated, no spaces, e.g. WAIVER,DROP or WAIVER,FA,TRADE,DROP. With Check times set to auto, pickups, drops and trades made between waiver runs come in the next waiver run's email; set Check times to interval to get them within 15 minutes.

Config.Name: Send test email on start
Config.Description: Set to true, apply, and check your inbox to confirm the email settings work. Set back to false afterward. To check the league ID and cookies, open the container's Logs: 'Connected to' followed by your league's name means they work.

Config.Name: Email when nothing is new
Config.Description: Send a short 'No waiver claims today' email after a waiver run with no claims, so you know it's working. Paused automatically between seasons. Not sent with Check times set to interval.

Config.Name: Check every (minutes)
Config.Description: How often to check with Check times set to interval (or in a league without waivers).

Config.Name: Season
Config.Description: Blank follows your league's latest season automatically, including before it's renewed for the new year.

Config.Name: Minutes after waiver run
Config.Description: With Check times set to auto: how long after each scheduled waiver run to check. ESPN usually starts within a couple of minutes; if it hasn't processed the run yet, the app checks once a minute until it has.

Config.Name: Email existing activity on first start
Config.Description: true emails the league's recent activity the first time it starts, instead of only new moves.

Config.Name: Retries
Config.Description: If a scheduled check can't reach ESPN, how many times to try again.

Config.Name: Minutes between retries
Config.Description: Wait between retries.

Config.Name: Alert after failures
Config.Description: Failed checks in a row before the one-time 'can't reach your league' email. Blank: after a fixed-time check's retries, or 8 checks (2 hours) otherwise.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the Data folder. 99 (nobody) is the Unraid default.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the Data folder. 100 (users) is the Unraid default.
